title: Google News Scraper
description: Search Google News by keyword or read topic headlines for any country and language.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Keywords to search on Google News, one per line. Google News operators work too: "exact phrase", OR, -exclude, site:reuters.com, intitle:word.

topics.title: Topic headlines
topics.description: Also collect the current headlines of these Google News sections.

includeTopStories.title: Include top stories
includeTopStories.description: Also collect the Google News front page (top stories) for the chosen edition.

edition.title: Country and language
edition.description: Google News edition to use. You can also type any edition as COUNTRY:language, for example NG:en.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.sectionDescription: Use a time range for recent news, or a date range for a specific period. A date range takes priority.
timeRange.description: Only return articles published within this period. Applies to search queries.

dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: Start of the date range (UTC), as a date or relative, for example "3 days" for three days ago. Applies to search queries.

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: End of the date range (UTC, inclusive). Defaults to today.

splitByDay.title: Search each day separately
splitByDay.description: Google News returns at most about 100 articles per search. Searching each day of the date range separately collects many more articles for long periods.

maxItemsPerFeed.title: Max articles per search
maxItemsPerFeed.description: Maximum articles to keep from each search, day or topic. Google News itself returns up to about 100.

maxItems.title: Max articles in total
maxItems.description: Stop after this many articles across all searches and topics. 0 means no limit.

resolveUrls.title: Resolve publisher URLs
resolveUrls.description: Replace Google News redirect links with the original article URL on the publisher's site. Slower, and charged as a separate event for each resolved URL.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy keeps Google from rate-limiting the requests. The default works for most runs.
